inspection.method: Contact sheets every0.5s across entire clip; detail crops6.8–9.1 every0.1s,9.1–11.4 every0.1s,13.3–16.1 every0.2s; major visual cuts measured from per-frameMAE at144px. Audio analysed from PCM, not listened to.
inspection.limitations: Not a continuous real-time video playback; beat interpretation is inferred from signal, no song identity or listening claim.

settings_legible_at_14s.caution: These are source-app units; not transferable 1:1 to Royer without visual calibration.

proposed_native_edit.music: Use original AAC from musica-original.m4a, trim before15.7333s, optional short final fade; do not reuse TikTokoutro.

construction_intro.action: Original source still briefly, then clean isolated character settles.
Head, two hands/forearms and hair separate outward slightly, revealing clean base.
Show pivots/labels briefly; preview one gentle nod and secondary-follow motion.
Pieces reunite; subtle anticipation into music accent.

final_animation.head_motion: One soft down/up nod per approximately0.5573s; smooth rest and short downbeat compression; alternate a small tilt across two beats. Start modestly and calibrate to cutout.
final_animation.secondary_motion: Hands follow with lower amplitude and slight phase difference. Hair follows head with delayed overshoot, independently adjustable. Eyes blink less often than everybeat.
final_animation.controls: Tempo, phase/start, nod amplitude, tilt amplitude, pivot, follow delay, secondary amplitude, active interval. Keep each piece editable and formulas/procedural tools separate from blur or shake.
